title: FreeCORE
excerpt: FreeCORE carries TrueNAS CORE 13.3 forward as an independently maintained operating system on FreeBSD, with in-place upgrades to 15.0.
content_html:
FreeBSD® 15 · OpenZFS

© 2026 The FreeCORE Project Team.

FreeCORE is an independent fork of TrueNAS® CORE 13.3, rebased on FreeBSD 15 after upstream development of CORE ended.

FreeCORE is an independent project, not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by iXsystems, Inc. or The FreeBSD Foundation. TrueNAS® is a registered trademark of iXsystems, Inc. FreeBSD® is a registered trademark of The FreeBSD Foundation.
